text:
Bladder washout solution should be sterile, isotonic, and non-irritating—typically normal saline (0.9% NaCl)—and used at room or body temperature. The note claiming chilled irrigant is preferred is not standard practice; cold fluid can cause discomfort and hypothermia, so refrigeration until use is not recommended. Additives not intended for intravesical use should never be included.

CONFIDENCE: 85
